findings.description: The old code used urlsplit, which handled bracketed IPv6 hosts such as "[::1]:5000". partition(":") splits at the first colon, so sn_host becomes "[" and sn_port becomes ":1]:5000". app.run() then binds to host "[", and the later int(sn_port) raises ValueError. The old code also stripped brackets and lowercased the hostname, and that is lost too.
findings.suggestion: Keep using urlsplit(f"//{server_name}") for hostname and port, or use rpartition with bracket handling.
findings.title: SERVER_NAME parsing with partition(":") breaks IPv6 literals

findings.description: The old code used urlsplit(host_url).hostname or "localhost". The new code uses host.partition(":")[0]. For an IPv6 host such as "[::1]:5000" this yields "[", so the cookie domain is wrong and the session cookie is not sent on later requests. An empty host gives "" instead of "localhost". The hostname is also no longer lowercased.
findings.title: Cookie domain no longer falls back to localhost and breaks on IPv6 hosts
